#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

static bool inside;
static bool wordStart;
static int maxOutLen;
static int curOutLen;
static int insideWordCount;

static void process(char c) {
    if (c == '(') {
        inside = true;
        wordStart = true;
        curOutLen = 0;
    } else if (c == ')') {
        inside = false;
        curOutLen = 0;
    } else if (!inside) {
        if (c == '_') {
            curOutLen = 0;
        } else {
            curOutLen++;
            if (curOutLen > maxOutLen) {
                maxOutLen = curOutLen;
            }
        }
    } else {
        if (c == '_') {
            wordStart = true;
        } else if (wordStart) {
            insideWordCount++;
            wordStart = false;
        }
    }
}

static void reset() {
    inside = false;
    wordStart = true;
    maxOutLen = 0;
    curOutLen = 0;
    insideWordCount = 0;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    string line;
    while (getline(cin, line)) {
        if (line.empty()) continue;
        istringstream iss(line);
        int n;
        string s;
        iss >> n >> s;
        reset();
        for (int i = 0; i < n && i < (int)s.length(); i++) {
            process(s[i]);
        }
        cout << maxOutLen << " " << insideWordCount << "\n";
    }
    
    return 0;
}
